detail:
POLICY (Frank 2026-09-03; doc /home/lumen/instructions/playbooks/maintenance-window.md; state fleet.maintenance_window): dedicated window Mon 02:00-05:00 America/Los_Angeles for batched maintenance/upgrades/restarts, and REBOOTS only if boot-safety triple-checked. BUILD: (1) a way to mark a ticket needs-maintenance-window (a maint-window lane OR a needs-window tag) so the normal dispatcher SKIPS it during active hours. (2) a scheduler: a systemd timer with OnCalendar anchored to America/Los_Angeles (Mon 02:00) that MUST track DST, not a hardcoded UTC offset; it drains the maint-window queue, runs each op, and HARD-STOPS by 05:00 PT (never start an op that cannot finish and verify before 05:00). (3) REBOOT BOOT-SAFETY GATE, required before any reboot: (a) every needed service is enabled, not just active; (b) no pending config/unit change blocks boot (systemd-analyze verify clean, fstab and network sane); (c) node auto-returns: AC-restore on, or a confirmed remote power/console path exists. NEVER reboot a node whose auto-return is unknown (thoth and apis lessons). Any check fails: skip the reboot, alert, do not proceed. (4) fail-safe: an op that errors stops the batch and alerts via ntfy, never cascades; a stall or failure in-window SCREAMS (ties wq#1369). (5) route wq#1396 disruptive proposals (upgrades, reboots) to this queue instead of live lanes. RESEARCH FIRST: dispatcher skip logic, systemd OnCalendar timezone support, existing reboot/power tooling (plug-ctl, per-node AC-restore facts). Done: disruptive tickets defer to the window; scheduler runs them Mon 02:00-05:00 PT; reboot gate enforced and tested; hard-stop enforced; promoter routes here.
[NO-PROBE: Frank must choose between an in-window slot and an explicit authorisation to edit the live dispatcher now; no deterministic check can decide that]
title: Maintenance-window scheduler: batch disruptive ops into Mon 02:00-05:00 PT with reboot-safety gate

detail: Design: research/NIGHTLY_DISPATCH_RESILIENCE.md (PR#282, read whole doc first) §1.3 + §6.1. (a) harness/harness_preflight.py:247 spawns bare 'claude'; lumen-foreman-dispatch.service PATH lacks /home/lumen/.npm-global/bin so every wq#1372 auto-reprove fails FileNotFoundError (dispatcher.log auto_reproved count = 0 ever). Add CLAUDE_BIN = env FOREMAN_CLAUDE_BIN default /home/lumen/.npm-global/bin/claude (same default as fworker.py:2566) and use it at :253; ALSO add .npm-global/bin to the unit Environment=PATH. (b) harness/fworker.py:532 calls ntfy-send with --title/--priority; bin/ntfy-send:12-16 only parses -T/-p, so 162 LAUNCH_FAILURE alerts/48h went out at default priority with the title in the body. Use -T/-p. (c) test: grep -rn '"claude"' harness dispatcher orchestrator returns no bare spawn; test that run_live_proof under PATH=/usr/bin:/bin resolves the binary. Done: dispatcher.log shows auto_reproved from a timer-driven pass; lumen-fleet shows a LAUNCH_FAILURE with a real title and priority high.
title: Fix preflight claude spawn under systemd PATH; fworker ntfy flags
